A silicon has a doping density of acceptors $N_A = 4 \times 10^{18} / \text{ cm}^3$ in the P-type region and a doping density of donors $N_D = 3 \times 10^{15} / \text{ cm}^3$ in the N-type region. Determine the built in potential and the total space charge (depletion layer) width at $300 \text{ K}$.
What is ripple factor? Why ripple factor is so important in power supply? Derive the expression of ripple factor of a full wave rectifier using centre-tap transformer.

A single phase full wave rectifier circuit consists of four diodes, a $250 \text{ \Omega}$ load resistance and it is fed from a $15\text{V}, 50 \text{ Hz}$ ac power supply. The forward resistance of each diode is $25 \text{ \Omega}$. Determine the dc output voltage, dc load current and efficiency.
